reason: Under the heading Refreshing a dataset on a schedule, the quote states that in the Quick console you can create five schedules for each dataset.
Under the heading Can I try Quick for free?, the table row gives 30 days, up to 25 users per account, and the subscription fee and infrastructure fee waived.

The page lists 'Security group attached to the Amazon Quick network interface' under the parent bullet 'Inbound and outbound rules for these security groups:'. That parent bullet appears only in the surrounding text, so the component is really the inbound and outbound rules of that security group, not the security group itself as the claim says. The quotes do support the subnets and the elastic network interface components.
